about: What `open_set: true` needs of an endpoint config, as cases both validators must answer the same way: `open_set_problem` in tooling/src/vsv2_tooling/config_validate.py (tested in tooling/tests/test_open_set_config.py) and `EndpointDefinition::open_set_problem` in core/crates/vsv2-orchestrator/src/registry.rs (tested there). Each case starts from the real config named in `base`, replaces the keys in `set`, deletes the keys in `remove`, and says what the answer is: null, or the reason (the Rust text has "endpoint '<name>': " in front of it). A rule changed on one side and not the other fails a test on the side that was not changed once this file is updated.
